 Mudassir Hai Karam Maula Raza Ka.
Tabhi Tu Naqsh Yeh Likhta Bohat Hai.

بڑھا دے جو مجھے قارون سے بھی
تمہارے در کا اک سکہ بہت ہے
ہے دیوانہ درِ مولا رضا کا

metadata = metadata.replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"')

metadata = metadata.replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]\\n', '')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 20 verses in Urdu script and preserved their Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have 20 lines in the same stanza. Set the direction to RTL and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I treated the opening title and byline as metadata, recording the full poet name as Syed Mudassir Mehdi. I read “Hazari” as حاضری and “Amma” as اماں.
